# proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set (Resource)

Manages a named cluster firewall IP set through `/cluster/firewall/ipset`. Entries are managed with `proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set_entry`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set" "trusted" {
  name    = "trusted"
  comment = "Trusted management networks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable IP set name. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) IP set comment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) IP set name.
